record.paper_title: Periods of Integrals on Algebraic Manifolds: Summary of Main Results and Discussion of Open Problems
record.original_question: For the intermediate-Jacobian period domain D=U(n-q) x U(q) ∖ Sp(2n,R), whose points determine complex tori with q-convex polarizations and theta cohomology H^q(T_Omega,O(L_Omega)), what is the relationship between this theta cohomology and the automorphic cohomology of D/T?

evidence.quote: The domain D is the G-orbit of a suitable point in D
We agree to call Hq(Tn, 0(LS)) the /&e/a cohomology
find the relation between theta cohomology and automorphic cohomology.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $n \geq 1$ and $0 \leq q \leq n$. Consider the period domain
$$ D \;=\; U(n-q)\times U(q) \,\big\backslash\, \mathrm{Sp}(2n,\mathbb{R}), $$
viewed as the homogeneous space parametrizing complex tori $T_\Omega = \mathbb{C}^n/\Lambda_\Omega$ equipped with a non-degenerate alternating form whose associated hermitian form has signature $(n-q,q)$ (a $q$-convex polarization). For each point $\Omega \in D$, this polarization determines a holomorphic line bundle $L_\Omega \to T_\Omega$, and one defines the theta cohomology of the polarized torus as
$$ H^q\bigl(T_\Omega,\, \mathcal{O}(L_\Omega)\bigr). $$
As $\Omega$ varies, these spaces fit together into a coherent object on $D$. Let $\Gamma \subset \mathrm{Sp}(2n,\mathbb{Z})$ be an arithmetic subgroup acting on $D$, and consider the automorphic cohomology of the quotient $D/\Gamma$, namely the Dolbeault (or sheaf) cohomology groups $H^*(D/\Gamma, \mathcal{L})$ for the natural homogeneous line/vector bundles $\mathcal{L}$ on $D$ descending to $D/\Gamma$.

Problem: Determine the precise relationship between the theta cohomology groups $H^q(T_\Omega, \mathcal{O}(L_\Omega))$, regarded collectively as a family parametrized by $D$, and the automorphic cohomology of $D/\Gamma$. In particular, construct a natural map (or spectral sequence) relating these two cohomology theories and identify its image, kernel, and any duality it satisfies.
artifact.status_search_result: No definitive resolution of the precise relationship between theta cohomology on $q$-convex polarized complex tori and automorphic cohomology of the corresponding non-classical Sp(2n,R)/U(n-q)×U(q) period domain quotients was located. While related work on theta functions for indefinite polarizations and on automorphic cohomology on non-classical period domains (e.g., by Carayol, Green–Griffiths–Kerr, Eastwood) exists, the search did not return an authoritative source stating that this specific correspondence has been fully established in general.

status_evidence.title: Holomorphic Automorphic Forms and Cohomology
status_evidence.snippet: Treats automorphic cohomology classes and Eichler-type maps, but in classical settings rather than for indefinite Sp(2n,R) period domains.
status_evidence.claim: Related framework but does not resolve the theta vs. automorphic cohomology comparison for q-convex polarizations.

status_evidence.title: Intermediate Jacobian (nLab)
status_evidence.snippet: Surveys intermediate Jacobians and their cohomological interpretations without addressing the comparison with automorphic cohomology on non-classical period domains.
status_evidence.claim: No explicit statement of the relationship sought.
